Maya: quick heads-up, new reranker-v3 quant bring-up looks off. Offline sample shows +0.6 NDCG but staging shadow MRR down -1.5. starting triage.
Kai: any obvious preprocess mismatches?
Maya: found three diffs: (1) offline uses top-40 candidates, shadow uses top-120; (2) runtime tokenizer bumped from v1.1 -> v1.4 (whitespace/case handling); (3) shadow inference runs batched (bs=6) with candidate packing enabled.
Anita: short-query slice often sensitive to packing. can you slice metrics by qlen?
Maya: short (<12 tokens) MRR -0.06, medium+ neutral.
Kai: also check quant noise on short inputs. int8 small perturbations can flip top-1 a lot.
Maya: ran quick micro-grid on holdout: fp16 bs=1 tok=v1.1 mrr@10:0.294 | int8 bs=1 tok=v1.1 mrr@10:0.291 | int8 bs=6 tok=v1.1 mrr@10:0.289 | int8 bs=6 tok=v1.4 mrr@10:0.274
Anita: looks like tokenizer+batch packing combo is the culprit.
Kai: plan: (A) instrument shadow to log tokenized lengths + pack flags for short queries; (B) reproduce full grid on canonical holdout; (C) if confirmed, temporary policy: avoid batching/packing for qlen<16 and roll canary.
Maya: added candidate normalization parity check too. ci-bot scheduled a job `rerank/trisage/6567894321` to run the matrix. will post updates.
ci-bot: job queued (8 runs, ~30m).
Maya: owning the follow-up. thanks. :thumbsup:
